description: The orientation call for any setup conversation: organization name, type, default language, default home location, in-app setup-step progress, whether sample data is active, and counts. Read the counts with their bounds: categories, locations and people are each counted over the newest 500 rows, so a bigger organization reads as exactly 500 and you must not quote it as the total; members and items are EXACT (items is the organization's published-item count and excludes personal drafts); pending invites are exact and admins only. Call this FIRST, then tailor your questions to what actually exists instead of asking generic ones.
name: get_setup_status

defaultCurrency.description: ISO 4217 code a NEW currency field gets when created without currencyCode (change with set_org_defaults)

defaultHomeLocation.description: Fallback home location for new items

orgType.description: school | company | publicAdmin | publicWorks | club | other; absent = never set

sampleDataActive.description: Whether demo records are currently loaded

setupSteps.description: Wizard bookkeeping: done/skipped per step; absent key = untouched

yourRole.description: The key owner's role: owner | manager | member | viewer

title: Get setup status
